EX series

EX Trainer Kit Latias

Released June 1, 2004 · 10 cards

EX Trainer Kit Latias is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on June 1, 2004. It has 10 cards. It includes 7 Pokémon, 2 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
